provenance.export_method: Activity page on strava.com > manual export of original FIT file
provenance.notes: First strava-sourced record in the reference. Filename derives from the Strava activity title ('Z4 Hill Repeats' -> Z4_Hill_Repeats.fit), not the numeric ID pattern used by garminconnect exports. The underlying activity was originally recorded on the same device as garmin-fenix7prosolar-garminconnect-singleexport-running-001, giving a same-device, different-platform comparison.

primary.notes: software_version field absent from file_id/device_info in this export (populated in the equivalent garminconnect export).

sensors.notes: Internal barometric altimeter module, per prior garminconnect record for this device.
MediaTek AG3335M GPS chip embedded in the Fenix 7 Pro Solar. Identity carried over from garmin-fenix7prosolar-garminconnect-singleexport-running-001 (same product code).

Garmin HRM-Dual chest strap, identity carried over from the equivalent garminconnect record. Paired at recording time, but this export contains no heart_rate field anywhere in record/session/lap messages — see key finding below.
No manufacturer or product fields populated, consistent with prior record.
Unknown internal module, unresolved in prior record too. No manufacturer or product fields populated.
Wrist heart rate optical module. No manufacturer or product fields populated.

activity.notes: No activity_display_name field present in this export (session def_num 110 absent entirely, not just empty).

device_info.notes: 8 devices x 2 timestamps (activity start and end), matching prior record's pattern.

unknown_312.notes: Registry-confirmed as 'split' (ffv_undocumented). Count of 27 across 17 laps does not map 1:1 to laps; consistent with the registry's existing note that split count does not correlate simply with lap count. First occurrence of this message type in a non-garminconnect (strava) source.

key_finding.title: Strava manual export is a stripped-down re-encode, not a passthrough of the original Garmin file
key_finding.summary: Compared to garmin-fenix7prosolar-garminconnect-singleexport-running-001 (same physical device), this strava-sourced export of what is presumably the same underlying recording contains none of the ~20 Garmin proprietary/undocumented message types (unknown_13, unknown_22, unknown_79, unknown_104, unknown_113, unknown_140, unknown_141, unknown_147, unknown_216, unknown_233, unknown_288, unknown_313, unknown_325, unknown_326, unknown_327, unknown_394, unknown_499) seen in the garminconnect export, and only unknown_312 (split) survives. Every field observed in record, session, and lap messages in this file is a plain FIT SDK field (registry_status sdk) -- zero garmin_proprietary or ffv_undocumented fields appear at all. Most notably, the heart_rate field (record def_num 3) is entirely absent, despite an HRM-Dual chest strap (garmin_product 3299) appearing in device_info as a paired sensor. device_info itself is also thinner: no software_version, hardware_version, or device_type fields populated for any entry, only device_index, manufacturer, and garmin_product/product.
key_finding.caveat: Cannot confirm from this file alone whether Strava strips these fields/messages during export, whether the original Garmin upload to Strava already lacked them, or whether 'Export Original' on strava.com returns a re-encoded file rather than the byte-identical upload. Would need a same-activity garminconnect export for direct comparison to confirm root cause.
